text: dsh-fetch-data 是一个 DSH 工具插件：它通过 Playwright 打开用户提供的网页，捕获页面返回的 JSON 接口，并按接口结构或指定字段路径整理数据。未指定字段时，工具展示推测的数据接口、结构摘要和接口菜单；指定接口与字段后，可提取标题、浏览量、评论数、价格等结构化值，并限制数组条数和字段长度。适合需要从网页动态数据中获取准确字段及其对应关系的场景。运行需要在 DSH profile 中安装 Playwright 和 Chromium；没有配置固定 API 密钥。

dsh-fetch-data uses Playwright to capture JSON responses from a supplied web page. It displays likely data endpoints and their structure, or extracts requested fields with limits on item count and value length. Playwright and Chromium are required in the DSH profile.
帮我从网页接口里拿到每条内容对应的点赞数和标题。
想查看一个网页加载时请求了哪些 JSON 数据接口。
Extract selected fields from a page's JSON API responses instead of getting flattened page text.
dsh-fetch-data 的功能「网页 JSON 字段提取」：捕获页面的 JSON 响应并展示接口结构。调用 fetch_data 时传入网址，可先查看接口菜单，再用 api 和 fields 指定接口及字段路径，结果按条数截断。
dsh-fetch-data 的功能「路径字段读取」：从捕获的 JSON 对象按点分隔路径读取字段，也支持数组展开和索引。fetch_data 的 fields 可指定多个路径，返回对应值，并限制数组项目数及单个值长度。
dsh-fetch-data 使用 Playwright 访问调用者提供的网址，并读取该页面返回的 JSON 数据接口；请求目标由调用参数决定，登录受限的接口可能无法获取。
dsh-fetch-data 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 87 天；提交数 4；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-fetch-data README · dsh-fetch-data：🌐 **English** | [中文](README.zh.md)

**Structured data extractor for DeepSeek Harness** — intercepts a page's real data APIs (XHR/fetch JSON) and returns **precise fields** (comment like-counts, rankings, prices, tables) that text extractors lose when flattening HTML.

**read_url answers "what does this page say?" — fetch_data answers "what are the exact numbers/data behind it?"**

dsh-fetch-data README · Why it exists：| | read_url (text extractor) | **fetch_data** (this plugin) |
|---|---|---|
| Reads | cleaned page text / Markdown | the page's **underlying JSON APIs** |
| Output | prose the model reads | **structured fields** (`{title, view}` pairs) |
| Strength | reading articles/docs | **exact field attribution** — which number belongs to which row |
| Weakness | flattened text loses number↔item association | requires playwright (browser engine) |

dsh-fetch-data README · Why it exists：Real example: on a Xiaoheihe post, `read_url` returned `"60125"` with no way to know if it meant 60 likes + 125 favorites or anything else. `fetch_data` intercepts `/bbs/app/link/tree` and returns `{user, up, content}` — unambiguous.
dsh-fetch-data README · Tool：**`fetch_data(url, api?, fields?, maxItems?)`** — capture the page's data APIs and extract fields

dsh-fetch-data README · Tool：| Param | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | string | required | http(s) page whose data APIs to capture |
| `api` | string | auto | Pin a specific endpoint from the structure-mode menu (e.g. `"/x/web-interface/ranking/v2"`); auto-selected when omitted |
| `fields` | string | structure mode | Comma-separated field paths to extract; arrays via `[]`: `"data.list[].title,data.list[].view"` |
| `maxItems` | number | 20 | Max array items per extracted field (1–100) |

dsh-fetch-data README · Tool：**Two modes:**

1. **Structure mode** (no `fields`) — returns the auto-picked endpoint's 2-level structure plus a **menu of all JSON APIs** (path · size · array?), so the model can re-call with `api=` to pin one:
```
页面 25 个 JSON 接口
选中: /x/web-interface/ranking/v2 (137763B)
结构: { code: number, message: string, ttl: number, data: { note: string, list: [100] { aid: number, ... } } }

dsh-fetch-data README · Tool：2. **Field mode** (with `fields`) — extracts exact values, arrays truncated at `maxItems`:
```
data.list[].title (前5条):
  用MC还原《神的随波逐流》 【B萌应援】
  WasteTheFallen丨首曝PV＆实机演示：凝视深渊，人性渐泯
  ...

dsh-fetch-data README · Auto-pick logic：Ranks captured JSON responses: **largest one containing an array wins** (data endpoints are usually big and array-bearing; tracking/config endpoints are small). Falls back to the largest JSON. Manual `api=` overrides.

dsh-fetch-data README · Real-world verification (2026-08-16, v0.1.3)：14-site sweep: **12 OK / 2 static-site expected errors / 0 crashes** — driven by `multi-site.mjs` (committed). Auto-scroll (lazy-load capture) + JSONP parsing verified live.

dsh-fetch-data README · Real-world verification (2026-08-16, v0.1.3)：| Site | Result |
|---|---|
| Bilibili popular ranking | ✅ auto-picked `/x/web-interface/ranking/v2` (139KB, `list[100]`), extracted titles + play counts, 1:1 attributed |
| Juejin feed | ✅ auto-picked `/recommend_api/v1/article/recommend_all_feed`, extracted article titles |
| Weibo | ✅ captured `/ajax/feed/hottimeline` (240KB) + `/ajax/statuses/config` (745KB, oversized config edge case) |
| QQ news | ✅ captured `/getQNChannels` (304KB, 36 APIs) |
| Douban | ✅ captured `/rexxar/api/v2/search/hots` |
| Taobao | ✅ captured 20 JSON APIs incl. mtop config (824KB, oversized-config edge case) |
| JD | ✅ captured `/wp-json/news/list` + `/category/get` |
| Zhihu / Baidu / CSDN / Netease / Xiaoheihe | ✅ captured their JSON endpoints (some are config/menu APIs — use structure mode to pick the data one) |
| example.com / ruanyifeng.com (static) | ✅ clear "no JSON API captured" error, no crash |

dsh-fetch-data README · Real-world verification (2026-08-16, v0.1.3)：- **18 zero-dep assertions** (field-path extractor, pick logic, structure summary, static-asset filter, truncation precision, description-length guard, JSONP parsing) + **22 live-interception assertions** (incl. scroll-triggered lazy capture + JSONP extraction) all green.
